settings.text: Made to order in 3–5 days, then posted

settings.heading: Sizing
settings.content:
Measure your pet's neck, add about 5cm, and pick the size that covers it. Between sizes? Go up — the ties are forgiving.

  • XS — 20–28cm neck
  • S — 28–36cm
  • M — 36–46cm
  • L — 46–58cm

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Cold machine wash inside out, hang to dry. Don't tumble dry, and if you iron it, avoid going directly over the print.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content: UK delivery 2–3 days after your bandana is made. Because each one is personalised it can't be returned unless there's a fault — but if something's wrong, message me and I'll fix it.

settings.personalise_intro: I draw every bandana from scratch. Tell me who it's for and I'll take it from there.
